summary: End-to-end testing of Fase 1B Werkpostbibliotheek (backend + frontend). All 16 pytest backend tests passed against the public URL. Full frontend flow (login -> /werkposten -> create -> edit with price change -> price history -> duplicate -> search -> soft delete -> 'Inactieve tonen' toggle) succeeded; cleanup via hard delete also verified.

issues: Accessibility warning: DialogContent missing aria-describedby/Description. Non-blocking, but a11y improvement recommended.

action_items: Optional: add DialogDescription (or aria-describedby) to werkpost form dialog and price-history dialog to silence Radix a11y warnings.
Optional: confirm that legacy items with category 'Algemeen' (66 items) is expected after enabling 'Inactieve tonen'.
critical_code_review_comments: werkposten.py update_werkpost(): exclude_unset=True is used but then `v is not None or k in ('description','standard_price')` strips legitimate None updates for other fields (e.g., productivity_profile=None). This is intentional but worth a comment.

Auto-discipline-order only fires when payload.discipline_order == 18 (the default). If a client sends an explicit different value, it is respected. Behavior is correct but subtle — consider documenting.
Endpoints have no auth dependency (consistent with /api/meetstaat per main agent note). If werkposten contains business-sensitive pricing, recommend protecting in a future iteration.
WerkpostenPage.js: ~550 lines — still maintainable but approaching split threshold; consider extracting FormDialog/HistoryDialog into sub-components.
seed_data_creation: Test werkposten were created during tests and fully cleaned up via hard delete (?soft=false).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Werkposten module fully validated end-to-end on iteration 17. Pytest suite /app/backend/tests/test_werkposten.py covers list/categories/create/auto-discipline/update+price_history/history/duplicate/soft+hard delete/errors. Frontend testIDs verified: werkposten-page, add-werkpost-btn, werkpost-search, werkpost-category-filter, toggle-inactive, form-name/category/unit/price/vat/discipline, form-productivity-toggle, form-prod-value, add-material-row, save-werkpost-btn, werkpost-card-{id}, edit/duplicate/delete/history-{id}, werkpost-form-dialog, history-dialog. Auto-discipline-order=12 for category 'Gyproc' confirmed both via API and via frontend create flow.
